sentences.text: For this floating-rate loan to an individual for a purpose other than business, the UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. (E10)
Because pre-payment charges are not permitted for this case, the rate to use is 0%. (E10)
The older RBI directions on pre-payment charges were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23. (R1, R2)

No other in-force rule in the materials gives a charge rate for this case, because the applicable in-force rule says not to levy pre-payment charges and the fallback policy rule applies only to cases other than paragraph 261(1) and (2). (E10, E16)
